intro:
Canada is one of the world's most popular study destinations for international students, known for its high-quality education, respected universities and welcoming multicultural society.

Canada combines affordable, high-quality education with generous post-graduation work permits and a well-defined permanent residency pathway — the reason it is the most PR-friendly destination for Indian students.
why: Post-Graduation Work Permit up to 3 years
Express Entry and PNP pathways to permanent residency
Lower tuition than the USA, UK and Australia
Safe, multicultural cities with large Indian communities
visa: Study Permit, usually via SDS-style documentation: acceptance letter, GIC, first-year tuition payment, IELTS and medical examination.
intakes: Three intakes — September (largest), January and May. Apply 6–9 months ahead; GIC and medicals take time.

req.label: Academics
req.value: 65%+ in bachelor's; 3-year degrees accepted for many programmes

req.label: English test
req.value: IELTS 6.5 with no band below 6.0 (SDS requirement)

req.label: Funds
req.value: GIC of CAD 20,635 plus first-year tuition payment

req.label: Documents
req.value: SOP, LORs, transcripts, passport, medicals, PAL/TAL letter

sch.name: University entrance awards
sch.text: Automatic merit awards on admission at many institutions

sch.name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship
sch.text: Merit-based funding for graduate research students

steps.title: Get the LOA
steps.text: Accept the offer and pay first-year tuition

steps.title: Buy GIC
steps.text: Purchase a Guaranteed Investment Certificate from an approved bank

steps.title: Secure PAL/TAL
steps.text: Province issues the attestation letter needed for the permit

steps.title: Medicals + application
steps.text: Complete upfront medical exam and submit the study permit application

steps.title: Biometrics
steps.text: Give biometrics; SDS decisions are usually quick

work: You may work 24 hours a week off campus during terms and full time in scheduled breaks. A Post-Graduation Work Permit of up to 3 years follows, feeding directly into Express Entry and Provincial Nominee PR pathways.
workPoints: Express Entry / PNP route to PR

faq.q: Is a 3-year degree accepted in Canada?
faq.a: Yes, most Canadian universities and colleges accept 3-year Indian bachelor's degrees for master's and PG diplomas.

faq.q: What is the GIC used for?
faq.a: GIC stands for Guaranteed Investment Certificate. A student deposits money for living expenses with an eligible Canadian financial institution, and the funds are released to the student in instalments after arrival.
September has the widest course choice; January and May are good for faster starts.

faq.q: Does college study qualify for PGWP?
faq.a: Yes, when the programme and institution are PGWP-eligible — we verify this before you apply.
